F1.source_title: MSD Veterinary Manual – Infectious Diseases of the Urinary System
F1.evidence_text: Signs of cystitis include loss of control over urination, frequent urination, urine dribbling, urine scalding, and straining to urinate.
F1.statement: Häufigkeit und Begleitzeichen des Urinierens sind wichtig.

F2.source_title: MSD Veterinary Manual – Infectious Diseases of the Urinary System
F2.evidence_text: A urine sample is needed to diagnose bacterial cystitis.
F2.statement: Für die Diagnose einer Blasenentzündung kann eine Urinprobe notwendig sein.

F3.source_title: MSD Veterinary Manual – Noninfectious Diseases of the Urinary System
F3.evidence_text: Usually, the earliest signs are unexplained weight loss, excessive thirst, and excessive urination.
F3.statement: Auch Erkrankungen der Nieren können vermehrtes Urinieren verursachen.

F4.source_title: MSD Veterinary Manual – Noninfectious Diseases of the Urinary System
F4.evidence_text: These tests are also used to check the response to treatment and monitor complications related to the kidney disease.
F4.statement: Für eine Abklärung sind wiederholte Untersuchungen möglich.
